meta.text: Now the analysis, and this is the crucial insight. Auto Loader persists schema state inside the checkpoint. So when you change the reader option but reuse the same old checkpoint, the fix silently does nothing — the stream stays broken because it's still comparing against the stale checkpointed schema. You must account for the checkpoint lifecycle, not just the reader. That reuse-the-checkpoint mistake is the most frequent exam distractor on this topic. Notice how the method works because it treats the checkpoint, not the reader, as the source of truth for schema.
